verdict.rationale: Anytype's own local API uses issued API keys. Its OpenAPI spec documents that a key can be missing, unknown, revoked or expired, which implies per-key credentials with revocation and expiry that could be issued to an agent. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be limited to specific spaces, objects or read-only access, so the least-privilege part of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented permission scopes or read-only key option, per-space or per-object restriction of agent credentials, docs on issuing and managing agent-specific keys, independent or hands-on corroboration.
